description: Comeback Kid (Uncommon perk) in House of Pips: A scoring play made while you are behind adds 5 points.
html:
Perks › Uncommon

Comeback Kid

Uncommon perk · Scoring bonus

A scoring play made while you are behind adds 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

A scoring play gains +5 points for each copy when your match score is lower than Rival's at the moment you play. Being tied does not count.

At a glance

RarityUncommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 300 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Common perks.
